Scan cases for `pnpm --filter @orthodox-prayer-toolkit/app measure:ocr`: an image and, next to it, `<name>.txt` with the expected text (paragraphs separated by a blank line) and optionally `<name>.langs` with Tesseract codes (`deu+rus`).

- `troparion-tilted.jpg`: a rendered page (German and Russian, red rubrics), tilted 1.2°, JPEG quality 45.
- `troparion-small.jpg`: the same page at 700 px, JPEG quality 15 (letters about 10 px high).
